cases.note: 2k-character idea with a dozen normative rules

profile.name: adv-02-wall-of-text
profile.idea: A warehouse control service. Every request must carry a tenant identifier, and a request without one must be rejected before it reaches a handler. Stock must never go negative, and a reservation must be released if the order is cancelled within ten minutes. Barcode scans must be idempotent: the same scan id replayed must not decrement twice. Operators must be able to see why a pick failed, and every failure must name a machine-readable reason. Picking must continue when the label printer is offline, and queued labels must print in order when it returns. A cycle count must never modify stock without a supervisor approving the difference. Every manual adjustment must be attributed to a person and must appear in an audit trail that cannot be edited. The service must expose a versioned HTTP contract, must return one error envelope, and must never leak internal identifiers. Retries from the handheld must be safe for at least 24 hours. Data older than 400 days must be deleted unless a legal hold is in force, and the deletion must be recorded. Stock levels must be eventually consistent across two warehouses within five seconds. The supervisor view must work on a tablet in a warehouse with poor wifi.
